title: PALEXAMIND-FAADS: A Longitudinal Machine Learning Framework for Fairness in Online Examinations under Infrastructure Constraints
description:
PALEXAMIND-FAADS is research software for machine learning on Moodle examination records collected under unreliable connectivity. Version 2.1.0 is an audit release. It adds a script that rebuilds the features from the archived dataset (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23643942) and verifies them against the committed copy, and a script that regenerates every number, table and figure of the accompanying manuscript.

The analysis covers four parts: (1) a comparison of a naive and a leakage-controlled evaluation protocol for the released five-class pipeline; (2) circularity diagnostics for detecting disruption from features of the same session when the label is a rule on that session; (3) prospective prediction of substantial disruption from information available before a sitting, against an examination-type baseline; and (4) a selective-triage analysis of the predicted risk.

The v2.0 binary benchmark and the v2.0 SVE/BFI simulation are withdrawn; the reasons are documented in CHANGELOG_v2.1.md. All earlier code and outputs are retained unchanged for auditability.
